description: Defines data models for notes, including Note and NoteEntity classes, with database annotations, serialization, and utility functions for note manipulation.

classes.name: NoteEntity
classes.description: Represents the note data as stored in the database, with annotations for Room ORM and serialization.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: In-memory representation of a note with utility functions for content processing and conversion to NoteEntity.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the note is empty based on title, content, attachments, reminders, tags, and task list.

methods.name: stringToTaskList
methods.description: Converts the note content string into a list of NoteTask objects based on lines.

methods.name: mdToTaskList
methods.description: Parses markdown list syntax in content to create a list of NoteTask objects.

methods.name: toStorableContent
methods.description: Returns the note content as a string suitable for storage, converting task list to markdown if needed.

methods.name: taskListToMd
methods.description: Converts the task list into markdown formatted string.

methods.name: taskListToString
methods.description: Converts the task list into a plain string, optionally with checkmarks.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts the Note object into a NoteEntity for database storage.
